title: YOu get what you pay for...
text: YOu get what you pay for.... These dishes are notable for not being flat on the bottom.  It appears that they were pulled out of the molds too soon and warped some.  As a result, most of them have a small but definite rock.  They also have defects on the surfaces, primarily waviness.  You can use them okay, but be aware that there are cosmetic and functional issues.  If these matter, look elsewhere.

description: Oven Basics 2-Quart Glass Bake Dish-set of 3 all the same size. Anchor Hocking Oven Basics bake ware is classic in shape, bakes evenly and cleans easily. The oversized capacities are perfect for cooking and re-heating . Safe for oven, microwave, refrigerator, freezer and tabletop! . Made of Soda Lime Glass in the United States. Dishwasher safe.Classic style and elegance.

Give your baked creations the presentation they deserve with this 13-inch cake platter and 11-inch glass cake dome from Anchor Hocking. With its retro 1950s styling and elegant height, this piece is a fit throne for confections of all shapes--and it helps keep baked goods fresh if dessert eaters are on their own schedules. The smoothly curved dome is accented by the sturdy glass handle. Best of all, Anchor Hocking designs the piece for use as a punch bowl, too--just invert both parts and fill with a favorite party beverage. Crafted from sturdy, thick glass, both dome and stand can go through the dishwasher.
